newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee slightly firmer on dollar, pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee slightly firmer on dollar, pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee was slightly firmer against both the dollar and pound on Thursday, reflecting international trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a mean commercial rate of 20.2525 against the dollar from 20.2565 on Wednesday. Against the pound, the rupee was quoted at a mean rate of 32.6790 from 32.6875 on Wednesday.
Forex dealers said the rupee's fixing on Thursday was in line with the dollar's trend in overnight international markets.
"We are simply following what is taking place abroad. On the local front, no big thing is happening that would influence the rupee," one dealer said.
During the week, the rupee has weakened versus the dollar from a mean of 20.1115 last Friday, reflecting the US currency's strength in international markets, dealers said.
The central bank was seen selling dollars in the interbank forex market during an intervention on Tuesday to dampen the effect of a bullish dollar in overseas markets, they added.
"Central bank interventions during these days are rather pointing towards a stable rupee as opposed to a strengthening since late 1996," the dealer said.
